Test Case Title: Search with valid keyword - exact match
Test Description: Verify search returns exact matching items
Preconditions:
1. Vue 3 list component is loaded
2. Multiple items are displayed in the list
Test Steps:
1. Locate the search input field
2. Enter exact item name/keyword: 'Product A'
3. Press Enter or click Search button
4. Verify search results
Expected Result:
1. Only items matching 'Product A' should be displayed
2. Non-matching items should be hidden
3. Result count should be updated
4. Search term should remain in search field

Test Description: Verify search returns items with partial matches
Preconditions:
1. Component is loaded
2. Multiple items exist (e.g., 'Product A', 'Product B', 'New Product')
Test Steps:
1. Enter partial keyword: 'Product'
2. Execute search
3. Observe filtered results
Expected Result:
1. All items containing 'Product' should be displayed
2. Items: 'Product A', 'Product B', 'New Product' should show
3. Result count should show number of matches
4. Search should be case-insensitive (verify)

Test Description: Verify behavior when search returns no results
Preconditions:
1. Component is loaded
2. Items are displayed
Test Steps:
1. Enter keyword that doesn't match any item: 'XYZ123NoMatch'
2. Execute search
3. Verify empty state
Expected Result:
1. No items should be displayed
2. 'No results found' or empty state message should appear
3. Original list should be recoverable by clearing search
4. UI should not break

Test Case Title: Clear search and restore original list
Test Description: Verify clearing search restores the original list
Preconditions:
1. Component is loaded
2. Search has been performed with active filter
Test Steps:
1. Locate search field with existing search term
2. Clear the search field (delete text or click clear button)
3. Verify list restoration
Expected Result:
1. All original items should be displayed again
2. List should return to previous state (page, view mode, etc.)
3. Result count should show total items
4. Filters should remain if any

Test Description: Verify search handles special characters correctly
Preconditions:
1. Component is loaded
2. Items may contain special characters
Test Steps:
1. Enter search with special characters: '@Product#1'
2. Execute search
3. Verify results
Expected Result:
1. Search should handle special characters safely
2. Matching items should be displayed
3. No JavaScript errors
4. XSS attempts should be prevented

Test Description: Verify search executes with debounce during typing
Preconditions:
1. Component is loaded
2. Real-time search is enabled
Test Steps:
1. Start typing in search field: 'P-r-o-d-u-c-t'
2. Observe when search executes
3. Verify debounce behavior
Expected Result:
1. Search should not execute on every keystroke
2. Should wait for user to pause typing (300-500ms typical)
3. Results should update after debounce period
4. Performance should be optimized

Test Case Title: Search persistence across view mode changes
Test Description: Verify search results persist when switching view modes
Preconditions:
1. Component is loaded
2. Search has been performed with results shown
Test Steps:
1. Perform search: 'Product'
2. Note the filtered results
3. Switch from List to Grid view
4. Switch to Compact view
5. Verify search results
Expected Result:
1. Same filtered results should display in all view modes
2. Search term should remain in search field
3. Result count should remain consistent
4. No items should be added/removed

Test Description: Verify search works correctly when combined with active filters
Preconditions:
1. Component is loaded
2. Filter is already applied (e.g., Category = 'Electronics')
Test Steps:
1. Apply a filter: Category = 'Electronics'
2. Perform search: 'Phone'
3. Verify combined results
Expected Result:
1. Results should match both filter AND search criteria
2. Only 'Phone' items in 'Electronics' category should show
3. Both filter and search should be active
4. Clearing one should keep the other active

Test Description: Verify applying a single filter correctly filters the list
Preconditions:
1. Component is loaded
2. Multiple items with different attributes exist
Test Steps:
1. Locate filter dropdown/panel
2. Select filter: Status = 'Active'
3. Apply filter
4. Verify filtered list
Expected Result:
1. Only items with Status = 'Active' should display
2. Filter indicator should show active filter
3. Result count should update
4. Other items should be hidden

Test Description: Verify multiple filters work together (AND logic)
Preconditions:
1. Component is loaded
2. Items have multiple filterable attributes
Test Steps:
1. Open filter panel
2. Apply first filter: Category = 'Electronics'
3. Apply second filter: Status = 'Active'
4. Apply third filter: Price Range = '$100-$500'
5. Verify results
Expected Result:
1. Only items matching ALL filter criteria should display
2. All three filters should show as active
3. Result count should reflect combined filters
4. Filters should use AND logic

Test Description: Verify removing one filter from multiple active filters
Preconditions:
1. Component is loaded
2. Multiple filters are active
Test Steps:
1. Apply 3 filters (Category, Status, Price)
2. Note the filtered results
3. Remove one filter: Status
4. Verify updated results
Expected Result:
1. Results should expand to include items matching remaining filters
2. Only Status filter should be removed
3. Other filters (Category, Price) should remain active
4. Result count should increase

Test Description: Verify clearing all filters restores the complete list
Preconditions:
1. Component is loaded
2. One or more filters are active
Test Steps:
1. Apply multiple filters
2. Locate 'Clear All Filters' button
3. Click Clear All Filters
4. Verify list restoration
Expected Result:
1. All filters should be removed
2. Complete original list should be displayed
3. Filter indicators should be cleared
4. Result count should show total items

Test Description: Verify behavior when filter combination yields no results
Preconditions:
1. Component is loaded
2. Items are displayed
Test Steps:
1. Apply filter combination that matches no items
2. Example: Category = 'Electronics' AND Status = 'Deleted'
3. Verify empty state
Expected Result:
1. No items should be displayed
2. 'No items match the selected filters' message should appear
3. Filter indicators should remain active
4. User should be able to adjust filters

Test Description: Verify filter dropdown shows correct available options
Preconditions:
1. Component is loaded
2. Filter panel is accessible
Test Steps:
1. Click on Category filter dropdown
2. Verify available options
3. Check if options are sorted
4. Verify option counts if displayed
Expected Result:
1. All unique category values should be listed
2. Options should be sorted (alphabetically or by relevance)
3. Disabled options should be indicated if applicable
4. 'All' or 'None' option may be available

Test Description: Verify active filters persist when navigating between pages
Preconditions:
1. Component is loaded
2. Pagination is active
3. Filters are applied
Test Steps:
1. Apply filter: Status = 'Active'
2. Note results on page 1
3. Navigate to page 2
4. Navigate back to page 1
5. Verify filter persistence
Expected Result:
1. Filter should remain active on all pages
2. Only filtered items should appear on each page
3. Page content should be correctly filtered
4. Filter indicator should remain visible

Test Description: Verify switching to List view displays items correctly
Preconditions:
1. Component is loaded
2. Currently in Grid or Compact view
Test Steps:
1. Locate view mode selector
2. Click 'List' view option
3. Verify layout change
Expected Result:
1. Items should display in vertical list format
2. Each item should show full details (as per design)
3. One item per row
4. Layout should match AngularJS List view
5. View selector should highlight 'List' as active

Test Description: Verify switching to Grid view displays items in grid layout
Preconditions:
1. Component is loaded
2. Currently in List or Compact view
Test Steps:
1. Locate view mode selector
2. Click 'Grid' view option
3. Verify layout change
Expected Result:
1. Items should display in grid format (multiple columns)
2. Grid should be responsive (columns adjust to width)
3. Each item should show in card/tile format
4. Layout should match AngularJS Grid view
5. View selector should highlight 'Grid' as active

Test Description: Verify switching to Compact view displays condensed item list
Preconditions:
1. Component is loaded
2. Currently in List or Grid view
Test Steps:
1. Locate view mode selector
2. Click 'Compact' view option
3. Verify layout change
Expected Result:
1. Items should display in condensed format
2. Less vertical spacing between items
3. Minimal item details shown (essential info only)
4. Layout should match AngularJS Compact view
5. More items visible per screen

Test Case Title: View mode persistence across page reload
Test Description: Verify selected view mode persists after page reload
Preconditions:
1. Component is loaded
2. User has selected a specific view mode
Test Steps:
1. Switch to Grid view
2. Note the layout
3. Reload/refresh the page
4. Verify view mode on reload
Expected Result:
1. Grid view should be retained after reload
2. User preference should be saved (localStorage/state)
3. Layout should render in saved view mode
4. All data should be displayed correctly

Test Description: Verify Grid view adjusts columns based on screen width
Preconditions:
1. Component is loaded in Grid view
2. Browser/viewport is resizable
Test Steps:
1. Set Grid view
2. Start with desktop width (1920px)
3. Resize to tablet width (768px)
4. Resize to mobile width (375px)
5. Observe column adjustments
Expected Result:
1. Desktop: 4-6 columns (as designed)
2. Tablet: 2-3 columns
3. Mobile: 1-2 columns
4. Grid should reflow smoothly
5. No horizontal scrolling

Test Description: Verify view mode switching works correctly with filtered data
Preconditions:
1. Component is loaded
2. Filters/search are active with limited results
Test Steps:
1. Apply filter to show 10 items
2. Switch to List view
3. Switch to Grid view
4. Switch to Compact view
5. Verify display in each mode
Expected Result:
1. All view modes should display same filtered 10 items
2. Layout should change but data should remain consistent
3. No items should disappear or duplicate
4. Each view should be functional

Test Case Title: Layout matches AngularJS version - List view
Test Description: Verify List view layout exactly matches AngularJS implementation
Preconditions:
1. Both AngularJS and Vue 3 versions are accessible
2. Same data is loaded in both
Test Steps:
1. Open AngularJS version in List view
2. Open Vue 3 version in List view
3. Compare layouts side-by-side
4. Verify spacing, fonts, colors, alignment
Expected Result:
1. Item spacing should match exactly
2. Font sizes and styles should be identical
3. Colors and borders should match
4. Icon positions should align
5. Overall layout should be pixel-perfect or very close

Test Case Title: Layout matches AngularJS version - Grid view
Test Description: Verify Grid view layout exactly matches AngularJS implementation
Preconditions:
1. Both versions are accessible
2. Same data is loaded
Test Steps:
1. Open AngularJS version in Grid view
2. Open Vue 3 version in Grid view
3. Compare layouts
4. Check grid spacing, card design, responsiveness
Expected Result:
1. Grid columns should match at same viewport width
2. Card/tile design should be identical
3. Spacing between items should match
4. Hover effects should be same
5. Responsive breakpoints should align

Test Case Title: Layout matches AngularJS version - Compact view
Test Description: Verify Compact view layout exactly matches AngularJS implementation
Preconditions:
1. Both versions are accessible
2. Same data is loaded
Test Steps:
1. Open AngularJS version in Compact view
2. Open Vue 3 version in Compact view
3. Compare layouts
4. Verify item density and information display
Expected Result:
1. Item height and padding should match
2. Information displayed should be identical
3. Row hover effects should match
4. Font sizes should be same
5. Overall density should match

Test Case Title: Adjust item spacing in List view
Test Description: Verify ability to adjust vertical spacing between items in List view
Preconditions:
1. Component is loaded in List view
2. Item spacing control is available
Test Steps:
1. Locate item spacing control (slider/dropdown)
2. Note default spacing
3. Increase spacing to maximum
4. Decrease spacing to minimum
5. Set to medium
6. Verify visual changes
Expected Result:
1. Spacing control should be accessible
2. Adjusting should immediately change spacing
3. Minimum spacing: compact (e.g., 4px)
4. Maximum spacing: spacious (e.g., 20px)
5. Changes should apply to all items uniformly

Test Case Title: Adjust item spacing in Grid view
Test Description: Verify ability to adjust spacing between items in Grid view
Preconditions:
1. Component is loaded in Grid view
2. Item spacing control is available
Test Steps:
1. Switch to Grid view
2. Locate item spacing control
3. Adjust spacing from min to max
4. Observe grid gap changes
Expected Result:
1. Both horizontal and vertical gaps should adjust
2. Grid should remain properly aligned
3. Items should not overlap at minimum spacing
4. Layout should remain responsive
5. Setting should persist across view switches

Test Description: Verify item spacing setting persists across sessions
Preconditions:
1. Component is loaded
2. User has adjusted item spacing
Test Steps:
1. Set item spacing to maximum
2. Reload the page
3. Verify spacing on reload
Expected Result:
1. Custom spacing setting should be retained
2. Should be saved in localStorage or user preferences
3. All view modes should respect saved spacing

Test Description: Verify custom spacing works correctly across different screen sizes
Preconditions:
1. Component is loaded
2. Custom spacing is set
Test Steps:
1. Set item spacing to maximum
2. Resize browser from desktop to mobile
3. Verify layout at each breakpoint
Expected Result:
1. Spacing should scale appropriately for screen size
2. Mobile view may override with optimized spacing
3. No layout breaks should occur
4. Content should remain accessible

Test Description: Verify pagination controls display when items exceed page size
Preconditions:
1. Component is loaded
2. Total items exceed page size (e.g., 50 items, 10 per page)
Test Steps:
1. Load component with 50 items
2. Set page size to 10 items
3. Observe bottom of list
4. Verify pagination controls
Expected Result:
1. Pagination controls should be visible
2. Should show: Previous, Page numbers, Next
3. Current page should be highlighted (Page 1)
4. Total page count should be visible (1 of 5)
5. Previous button should be disabled on page 1

Test Description: Verify clicking Next button navigates to the next page
Preconditions:
1. Component is loaded with pagination
2. User is on page 1
Test Steps:
1. Note items displayed on page 1
2. Click 'Next' button
3. Verify page 2 loads
Expected Result:
1. Page 2 items should be displayed
2. Page 1 items should be hidden
3. Current page indicator should show '2'
4. Previous button should be enabled
5. Scroll position should reset to top (optional)

Test Description: Verify clicking Previous button navigates to the previous page
Preconditions:
1. Component is loaded with pagination
2. User is on page 2 or higher
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to page 2
2. Note items displayed
3. Click 'Previous' button
4. Verify page 1 loads
Expected Result:
1. Page 1 items should be displayed
2. Page 2 items should be hidden
3. Current page indicator should show '1'
4. Previous button should be disabled on page 1

Test Description: Verify clicking specific page number navigates directly to that page
Preconditions:
1. Component is loaded with pagination
2. Multiple pages available (5+ pages)
Test Steps:
1. User is on page 1
2. Click on page number '4'
3. Verify direct navigation
Expected Result:
1. Page 4 should load immediately
2. Appropriate items (31-40 if 10 per page) should display
3. Current page indicator should show '4'
4. Both Previous and Next should be enabled (if not last page)

Test Description: Verify 'First' button navigates to page 1
Preconditions:
1. Component is loaded with pagination
2. User is on page 3 or higher
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to page 3
2. Locate 'First' button (if available)
3. Click 'First' button
4. Verify navigation
Expected Result:
1. Page 1 should load
2. First page items should display
3. Previous button should be disabled
4. Current page should indicate '1'

Test Description: Verify 'Last' button navigates to the final page
Preconditions:
1. Component is loaded with pagination
2. User is on page 1 or middle page
Test Steps:
1. Note total page count (e.g., 5 pages)
2. Locate 'Last' button
3. Click 'Last' button
4. Verify navigation
Expected Result:
1. Last page (5) should load
2. Final set of items should display
3. Next button should be disabled
4. Current page should indicate last page number

Test Description: Verify changing page size recalculates pagination
Preconditions:
1. Component is loaded
2. Page size selector is available (10, 25, 50, 100)
Test Steps:
1. Note current pagination (e.g., 50 items, 10 per page = 5 pages)
2. Change page size to 25 items per page
3. Verify pagination updates
Expected Result:
1. Pagination should recalculate (50 items / 25 = 2 pages)
2. More items should display on current page
3. Total page count should decrease
4. User should remain on page 1 or appropriate page

Test Description: Verify pagination updates correctly when filters reduce item count
Preconditions:
1. Component is loaded
2. Pagination is active
3. Total items: 50 (5 pages)
Test Steps:
1. Note initial pagination (5 pages)
2. Apply filter that shows only 8 items
3. Verify pagination updates
Expected Result:
1. Pagination should recalculate (1 page if 10 per page)
2. Only filtered items should display
3. Page numbers should update accordingly
4. Pagination may hide if all items fit on one page

Test Case Title: Pagination controls hide with few items
Test Description: Verify pagination controls hide when all items fit on one page
Preconditions:
1. Component is loaded
2. Total items < page size (e.g., 5 items, 10 per page)
Test Steps:
1. Load component with only 5 items
2. Page size is set to 10
3. Observe pagination area
Expected Result:
1. Pagination controls should be hidden or disabled
2. All 5 items should display
3. No page numbers should show
4. UI should be clean without unnecessary pagination

Test Description: Verify view mode persists when navigating between pages
Preconditions:
1. Component is loaded with pagination
2. User selects Grid view
Test Steps:
1. Switch to Grid view on page 1
2. Navigate to page 2
3. Navigate to page 3
4. Verify view mode
Expected Result:
1. Grid view should be maintained on all pages
2. View mode should not reset to default
3. Items on each page should display in Grid view

Test Description: Verify pagination shows ellipsis when page count is very high
Preconditions:
1. Component is loaded
2. Many pages exist (e.g., 50 pages)
Test Steps:
1. Load component with 500 items (10 per page = 50 pages)
2. Observe pagination controls
3. Navigate to middle page (25)
Expected Result:
1. Should show: « 1 ... 24 25 26 ... 50 »
2. Ellipsis (...) should indicate hidden page numbers
3. Should show current page and few surrounding pages
4. First and last page numbers should always be visible

Test Description: Verify loading indicator appears when loading new page
Preconditions:
1. Component is loaded
2. Backend delay is possible (or simulated)
Test Steps:
1. Click to navigate to page 2
2. Observe loading behavior
3. Wait for page to load
Expected Result:
1. Loading spinner/indicator should appear briefly
2. Previous page content may remain visible or blur
3. New page content should replace old after loading
4. No flash of empty content

Test Case Title: Single selection mode - select one item
Test Description: Verify only one item can be selected at a time in single mode
Preconditions:
1. Component is loaded in single selection mode
2. Multiple items are displayed
Test Steps:
1. Verify mode indicator shows 'Single Select'
2. Click on first item to select
3. Verify selection (checkbox/highlight)
4. Click on second item
5. Verify selection changes
Expected Result:
1. First item should be selected initially (checkbox checked/highlighted)
2. When second item is clicked, first should be deselected
3. Only one item should be selected at any time
4. Selection indicator should be clear

Test Case Title: Multi selection mode - select multiple items
Test Description: Verify multiple items can be selected simultaneously in multi mode
Preconditions:
1. Component is loaded in multi selection mode
2. Multiple items are displayed
Test Steps:
1. Verify mode indicator shows 'Multi Select'
2. Click on first item to select
3. Click on second item to select
4. Click on third item to select
5. Verify all selections
Expected Result:
1. All three items should remain selected
2. Checkboxes should be checked for all three
3. Selection count should show '3 items selected'
4. All selected items should be highlighted

Test Description: Verify switching between single and multi selection modes
Preconditions:
1. Component is loaded
2. Items are selected in multi mode
Test Steps:
1. Set multi selection mode
2. Select 3 items
3. Switch to single selection mode
4. Observe behavior
Expected Result:
1. When switching to single mode, either:
   a) All selections clear, or
   b) Only first/last selection is retained
2. Mode indicator should update
3. Selection behavior should change immediately
4. No errors should occur

Test Case Title: Select all items in multi mode
Test Description: Verify 'Select All' functionality in multi selection mode
Preconditions:
1. Component is loaded in multi mode
2. Multiple items are displayed (e.g., 20 items on current page)
Test Steps:
1. Locate 'Select All' checkbox (typically in header)
2. Click 'Select All'
3. Verify all items are selected
Expected Result:
1. All items on current page should be selected
2. All checkboxes should be checked
3. Selection count should show total (e.g., '20 items selected')
4. 'Select All' checkbox should be checked

Test Description: Verify 'Deselect All' or unchecking 'Select All' clears selections
Preconditions:
1. Component is loaded in multi mode
2. Multiple items are selected
Test Steps:
1. Select 5 items manually
2. Click 'Select All' checkbox to uncheck (or 'Deselect All' button)
3. Verify all selections are cleared
Expected Result:
1. All items should be deselected
2. All checkboxes should be unchecked
3. Selection count should show '0 items selected'
4. 'Select All' checkbox should be unchecked

Test Case Title: Partial selection state in Select All
Test Description: Verify indeterminate state when some items are selected
Preconditions:
1. Component is loaded in multi mode
2. 10 items are displayed
Test Steps:
1. Select 3 out of 10 items manually
2. Observe 'Select All' checkbox state
Expected Result:
1. 'Select All' checkbox should show indeterminate state (dash/minus icon)
2. Indicates some but not all items are selected
3. Selection count should show '3 items selected'
4. Clicking 'Select All' should select remaining items

Test Description: Verify selected items remain selected when navigating pages
Preconditions:
1. Component is loaded in multi mode
2. Pagination is active
Test Steps:
1. On page 1, select items 2, 5, 8
2. Navigate to page 2
3. Select items 3, 7
4. Navigate back to page 1
5. Verify selections
Expected Result:
1. Items 2, 5, 8 should still be selected on page 1
2. Total selection count should show 5 items
3. Selections should persist across page navigation
4. Selected items on page 2 should also persist

Test Description: Verify Shift+Click selects range of items in multi mode
Preconditions:
1. Component is loaded in multi mode
2. At least 10 items are visible
Test Steps:
1. Click on item 2 to select
2. Hold Shift key
3. Click on item 7
4. Release Shift
5. Verify selection range
Expected Result:
1. Items 2 through 7 should all be selected (6 items total)
2. Range selection should be contiguous
3. Selection count should show '6 items selected'
4. All items in range should be highlighted

Test Description: Verify Ctrl+Click toggles individual item selection in multi mode
Preconditions:
1. Component is loaded in multi mode
2. Some items are already selected
Test Steps:
1. Select item 3
2. Hold Ctrl key (Cmd on Mac)
3. Click item 7 (should add to selection)
4. Ctrl+Click item 3 again (should deselect)
5. Verify behavior
Expected Result:
1. Ctrl+Click on unselected item should add to selection
2. Ctrl+Click on selected item should remove from selection
3. Other selections should remain unchanged
4. Selection count should update accordingly

Test Description: Verify keyboard arrows and spacebar work for selection
Preconditions:
1. Component is loaded
2. Focus is on the list
Test Steps:
1. Use Tab to focus on list
2. Use Arrow Down to move through items
3. Press Space to select/deselect focused item
4. Repeat for multiple items
5. Verify selections
Expected Result:
1. Arrow keys should move focus indicator
2. Spacebar should toggle selection of focused item
3. Selection should work with keyboard only
4. Visual focus indicator should be clear

Test Description: Verify selection count displays correctly
Preconditions:
1. Component is loaded in multi mode
2. No items are selected initially
Test Steps:
1. Verify initial state shows '0 items selected' or no count
2. Select 1 item, verify shows '1 item selected'
3. Select 4 more items, verify shows '5 items selected'
4. Deselect 2 items, verify shows '3 items selected'
Expected Result:
1. Count should update in real-time
2. Grammar should be correct (item vs items)
3. Count should be prominently displayed
4. Count should include selections across all pages if applicable

Test Description: Verify bulk actions can be performed on selected items
Preconditions:
1. Component is loaded in multi mode
2. Bulk action buttons are available (Delete, Export, etc.)
Test Steps:
1. Select 5 items
2. Locate bulk action button (e.g., 'Delete Selected')
3. Click bulk action button
4. Confirm action
5. Verify action completes
Expected Result:
1. Bulk action should apply to all selected items
2. Confirmation dialog should show count (e.g., 'Delete 5 items?')
3. Action should complete successfully
4. Items should update accordingly (deleted, exported, etc.)

Test Description: Verify selections are cleared after bulk action completes
Preconditions:
1. Component is loaded in multi mode
2. Items are selected and bulk action performed
Test Steps:
1. Select 3 items
2. Perform bulk action (e.g., Export)
3. Wait for action to complete
4. Verify selection state
Expected Result:
1. Selections should be cleared after action completes
2. Selection count should show 0
3. Checkboxes should be unchecked
4. User can start fresh selection

Test Description: Verify selection works correctly with filtered results
Preconditions:
1. Component is loaded in multi mode
2. Filter is applied
Test Steps:
1. Apply filter to show 8 items
2. Select 3 filtered items
3. Clear filter
4. Verify selection state
Expected Result:
1. 3 selected items should remain selected when filter is cleared
2. Selection should be visible in full list
3. Selection count should remain at 3
4. Selecting works on filtered subsets

Test Description: Verify user can enter view customization mode
Preconditions:
1. Component is loaded
2. Customize view option is available
Test Steps:
1. Locate 'Customize View' or settings icon
2. Click to enter customize mode
3. Verify mode activation
Expected Result:
1. Customize mode should activate
2. Visual indicators should show draggable fields
3. Instructions should display (e.g., 'Drag to reorder columns')
4. Drag handles should appear on field headers

Test Case Title: Drag and drop field to reorder
Test Description: Verify user can drag a field to a new position
Preconditions:
1. Component is in customize mode
2. Multiple fields are displayed (e.g., Name, Date, Status, Priority)
Test Steps:
1. Locate drag handle on 'Status' field
2. Click and hold on drag handle
3. Drag 'Status' to position before 'Name'
4. Release mouse
5. Verify new order
Expected Result:
1. Field should visually move while dragging
2. Drop indicator should show where field will be placed
3. After drop, 'Status' should appear before 'Name'
4. New order: Status, Name, Date, Priority
5. List items should reflect new field order

Test Description: Verify dragging a field to the first position works correctly
Preconditions:
1. Component is in customize mode
2. Current order: Name, Date, Status, Priority
Test Steps:
1. Drag 'Priority' field
2. Move it to the very first position (before Name)
3. Drop it
4. Verify new order
Expected Result:
1. 'Priority' should move to first position
2. New order: Priority, Name, Date, Status
3. All other fields should shift right
4. List view should update immediately

Test Description: Verify dragging a field to the last position works correctly
Preconditions:
1. Component is in customize mode
2. Current order: Name, Date, Status, Priority
Test Steps:
1. Drag 'Name' field
2. Move it to the very last position (after Priority)
3. Drop it
4. Verify new order
Expected Result:
1. 'Name' should move to last position
2. New order: Date, Status, Priority, Name
3. All other fields should shift left
